partial.sin: Native constants/truncation recovered; libm boundary/large-angle equality not Windows-tested.
partial.cos: Native constants/truncation recovered; libm boundary/large-angle equality not Windows-tested.
partial.tan: Native constants/truncation recovered; libm boundary/large-angle equality not Windows-tested.
partial.TimerWait: Remaining deadline implemented; native at-most100ms event-pump and all skip/quit abort predicates require runtime integration review.
partial.SoundLoadStream: Entry-bounded sources, background libsndfile/resampling worker and fixed 64 KiB PCM queue implemented for all sounds; native stream loop-start and logical source kind preserved. V6 consumed-position restore and v1-v5 migration validated; codec/device scheduling remains platform dependent.
partial.FileExistCheck: Filesystem provider uses glob; Windows case/wildcard/filename behavior not fully equivalent.
partial.FileExtract: State-confined output policy differs from unrestricted original path resolution.
partial.FileExtractDialog: Actual AppKit save-dialog provider implemented; Win32 dialog and filename semantics differ across platforms.
partial.Execute: Actual macOS shell-open provider implemented; Win32 process association/return behavior is not identical.
partial.CursorLoad: PNG/uncompressed24/32-bit CUR/ICO supported; other encodings explicitly reject.
partial.ScriptSubCall: Checkpoint/child/return flow tested, but native save output has no Windows execution validation.
partial.SaveDataSave: Native and Yukari codecs tested structurally; original Windows interoperability unverified.
partial.SaveDataLoad: Original VM/scene import implemented; all original scheduler/layout state not fully reproduced.
partial.UserTransition: Native software/GPU mask formulas and timing paths implemented and tested; Windows pixel/timing comparison remains unverified.
partial.Transition: All 32 native mode routes implemented, including software/GPU differences; full original-frame comparison remains unverified.
partial.DefaultFontSet: Raw LOGFONT family/height/width/weight and software DIB effects implemented; uncaptured FreeType glyphs remain substitutes. Native Windows typography requires authentic font and GDI capture validation.
partial.MoviePlay: Streaming MPEG and synchronized lifecycle tested; all original DirectShow media/cancellation/window behavior not equivalent.
partial.CD: Native command semantics and no-device behavior implemented; mounted CDDA AIFF provider tested with injected tracks, physical-drive playback unverified. See docs/cd-commands.md.
partial.CDWait: Native wall-clock subtraction and interruptible timed wait implemented; device playback uses independent provider.
partial.MIDIPlay: AudioToolbox MIDI synthesizer implemented; parser/unit tests pass, audible device playback not automatically verified.
